verdict.rationale: Discord is a communication platform that could plausibly embed an AI assistant able to consume MCP servers, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP or plugging in external tool servers. The bot, app, webhook and Gateway APIs are developer building blocks for integrations, not a native MCP-client capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
